# google_vertex_ai_model

A trained machine learning Model copied from an existing Model.


To get more information about Model, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.models)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs)

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Model Source Basic1


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_model" "model" {
  project = "my-project-name"
  source_model = "projects/my-project-name/locations/us-central1/models/7222055265628061696"

  region = "us-central1"
}
```
## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Model Source Basic2


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_model" "model" {
  model_id = "test-model"
  project = "my-project-name"
  source_model = "projects/my-project-name/locations/us-central1/models/7222055265628061696"

  region = "us-central1"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:



* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Description of the Model.

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Display name of the Model. Optional when copying a Model.

* `version_aliases` -
  (Optional)
  User-provided version aliases, managed after the Model is copied and on updates.
  Aliases are unordered. The API-required `default` alias is preserved when omitted
  from configuration and is only included in state when explicitly configured
  or when this field is unset.

* `encryption_spec` -
  (Optional)
  Customer-managed encryption key specification.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_encryption_spec).

* `custom_service_account` -
  (Optional)
  Optional service account used to copy the Model.

* `source_model` -
  (Optional)
  Resource name of the Model to copy.

* `model_id` -
  (Optional)
  ID for the new copied Model.

* `region` -
  (Optional)
  The region of the Model. eg us-central1

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_encryption_spec"></a>The `encryption_spec` block supports:

* `kms_key_name` -
  (Optional)

* `artifact_uri` -

* `create_time` -

* `update_time` -

## Import


Model can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/models/{{model_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{region}}/{{model_id}}`
* `{{region}}/{{model_id}}`
* `{{model_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import Model using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    modelId = "<-optional value->"
    region = "<-optional value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_vertex_ai_model.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Model using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/models/{{model_id}}"
  to = google_vertex_ai_model.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Model can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_model.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/models/{{model_id}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_model.default {{project}}/{{region}}/{{model_id}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_model.default {{region}}/{{model_id}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_model.default {{model_id}}
```
